title: POST /access_check: the request
description: The body, JSON, 8 KiB at most, sent as text/plain (so a browser sends no preflight) or application/json. The service trims and lower-cases access_id, portal, product and install_id before it checks them; the patterns are of that form. A field it does not know is ignored. ACCESS_CHECK.md, Request.

access_id.description: the account name the portal's dashboard shows, never a typed one

portal.description: the portal's hostname, a :port allowed; not a URL

product.description: bridge from every Beethoven build (beethoven is the same product); another short name is recorded under its own name

install_id.description: Beethoven 8.0.0 on: the random identifier made once per installation (32 hexadecimal characters); absent, null or empty from a build before
